hypothesis: Legacy holes and coveredness treat cavities mostly by vertical emptiness/depth. A separate lower-bound excavation cost for sealed empty components may distinguish side-accessible caves from pockets that require clearing blockers before they can be reached.

metric.domain: real post-placement board before optimistic T-slot cutouts
metric.component_definition: 4-neighbor connected empty cells below the global board surface
metric.component_cost: minimum number of occupied cells vertically above any cell in the component
metric.sky_access: if any cell in the component has zero blockers above it, component cost is zero
metric.aggregation: sum component cost once per empty component
metric.reason_not_to_multiply_by_component_size: existing holes already prices empty-cell count; H9 is intended to add accessibility/excavation information rather than duplicate hole count

screen.interpretation: Light excavation penalties (-0.5 and -0.75) were the tied screening leaders. Heavy penalties became clearly harmful, consistent with over-penalizing temporary structural debt. Screening alone does not promote H9.

protocol.speculation: SevenBag after visible preview, never true hidden future
protocol.incoming_garbage: 10 hidden-hole scenarios while under observed pressure

selection: screen shared seeds, fresh-seed validate survivors, then fixed-finalist fresh 400-KO confirmation
promotion_rule: H9 is not promoted from screening or validation. The fixed finalist must beat H6C in fresh confirmation. If not, H6C remains incumbent and H9 is recorded as rejected.
